9-UNITNING TO'RTINChI BETI (65-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'A World of Wonders' va TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '9'.

CHAP USTUN:
12) a) Kasseta belgisi: 'Choose the correct item, then listen and check.'
   1 America was discovered by ... a Christopher Columbus in 1492. b Louis Lumière in 1492.
   2 The telephone was invented by ... a Samuel Colt in 1786. b Alexander Graham Bell in 1876.
   3 The Mona Lisa was painted by ... a Paul Gaugin in 1698. b Leonardo da Vinci in 1506.
   4 The Parthenon was built by ... a the ancient Greeks in the 5th century BC. b the ancient Egyptians in the 3rd century BC.
   5 Romeo and Juliet was written by ... a William Wordsworth in 1695. b William Shakespeare in 1595.
   6 The Blue Danube was composed by ... a Richard Strauss in 1876. b Johann Strauss in 1867.
   b) 'In pairs, ask and answer questions using the passive voice, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya: SA: Who was America discovered by? SB: It was discovered by Christopher Columbus. SA: When was it discovered? SB: It was discovered in 1492. Who was the telephone invented by?
13) 'Put the verbs into the correct passive tense, then use the prompts (a-e) to ask and answer questions in pairs.'
   MATN (och ko'k quti, yirtiq): 'The Louvre is the national museum and art gallery of France. In 1546, work on the Louvre 1) ...... (start) by King Francis I. The Louvre 2) ...... (use) as a royal palace until 1682. It 3) ...... (open) to the public as a museum and art gallery in 1793. Today many of the world's most famous paintings 4) ...... (keep) in the Louvre, as well as sculptures, jewellery and other forms of art. It 5) ...... (visit) by millions of people every year.'
   Ko'k qiya: SA: When was work on the Louvre started? SB: Work on the Louvre was started in 1546.
   a When / work / the Louvre / start? b What / it / use as / until 1682? c When / the Louvre / open / to the public? d What / keep / in the Louvre? e How many people / it / visit / every year?

O'NG USTUN:
14) 'Complete each sentence using the word in bold, as in the example.'
   1 Steven Spielberg directed the film 'ET'. BY → 'ET' WAS DIRECTED BY Steven Spielberg. (ko'k qiya)
   2 The Russians launched Sputnik 1 in 1957. WAS → Sputnik 1 ...... in 1957.
   3 Millions of tourists visit London every year. VISITED → London ...... every year.
   4 They must repair the chapel immediately. REPAIRED → The chapel ...... immediately.
   5 The Queen will open the new gallery on Friday. BE → The new gallery ...... on Friday.
   6 They have redecorated the museum. BEEN → The museum ...... .
   7 Fleming didn't invent the TV. INVENTED → The TV ...... Fleming.
15) 'In pairs, ask and answer questions, then talk about each place, as in the example.' IKKI SURAT va QAYD QOG'OZLARI (skrepkali): Eyfel minorasi - Name: Eiffel Tower, Paris, France; Designer: Gustave Eiffel; Completed: 1889; Material: iron; Built as: memorial to the French Revolution. Parfenon - Name: Parthenon, Athens, Greece; Designer: Ictinus & Callicrates; Completed: 432 BC; Material: marble; Built as: temple of goddess Athena.
   Ko'k qiya namuna dialog va matn: 'SA: Where is the Eiffel Tower located? SB: It is located in Paris, France. Who was it designed by? SA: It was designed by Gustave Eiffel. When was it completed? SB: It was completed in 1889. What is it made of? SA: It is made of iron. Why was it built? SB: It was built as a memorial to the French Revolution.' 'The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, in France. It was designed by Gustave Eiffel and it was completed in 1889. It is made of iron. It was built as a memorial to the French Revolution.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '65'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs into the correct passive tense.
exercises.explanationUz:
LUVR MUZEYI - TO'LIQ MATN:

  'The Louvre is the national museum
  and art gallery of France. In 1546,
  work on the Louvre WAS STARTED by
  King Francis I. The Louvre WAS USED
  as a royal palace until 1682. It
  WAS OPENED to the public as a
  museum and art gallery in 1793.
  Today many of the world's most
  famous paintings ARE KEPT in the
  Louvre, as well as sculptures,
  jewellery and other forms of art.
  It IS VISITED by millions of people
  every year.'


⚠ ZAMON TANLOVI:

  1-3: 'In 1546', 'until 1682', 'in
     1793' → PAST SIMPLE majhul
  4-5: 'Today', 'every year' →
     PRESENT SIMPLE majhul


⚠ 'KING FRANCIS I':

  = 'King Francis the First'.
  ⚠ Qirollar tartib son bilan:
  'the First', 'the Second'.


⚠ 'A ROYAL PALACE':

  = qirollik saroyi.


⚠ 'THE PUBLIC':

  = jamoatchilik, omma.
  ⚠ 'open to the public' = omma
  uchun ochiq.


⚠ 'TO KEEP':

  keep - kept - KEPT.
  ⚠ 'are kept' = saqlanadi.

items.textEn: In 1546, work on the Louvre 1) ___ (start) by King Francis I.
The Louvre 2) ___ (use) as a royal palace until 1682.
It 3) ___ (open) to the public as a museum and art gallery in 1793.
Today many of the world's most famous paintings 4) ___ (keep) in the Louvre.
It 5) ___ (visit) by millions of people every year.

exercises.instructionEn: Then use the prompts (a-e) to ask and answer questions in pairs.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng ko'rsatmalardan (a-e) foydalanib juftlikda savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: When was work on the Louvre
      started?
  SB: Work on the Louvre was started
      in 1546.


⚠ MAJHUL SAVOLLAR:

  When WAS ... STARTED?
  What WAS it USED AS?
  When WAS ... OPENED?
  What IS KEPT in ...?
  How many people IS it VISITED BY?

  ⚠ Predlog ('as', 'by') gap
  OXIRIDA.

items.prompt: a When / work / the Louvre / start? (namuna)
items.question: SA: When was work on the Louvre started?
items.answer: SB: Work on the Louvre was started in 1546.

items.prompt: b What / it / use as / until 1682?
items.question: SA: What was it used as until 1682?
items.answer: SB: It was used as a royal palace until 1682.

items.prompt: c When / the Louvre / open / to the public?
items.question: SA: When was the Louvre opened to the public?
items.answer: SB: It was opened to the public in 1793.

items.prompt: d What / keep / in the Louvre?
items.question: SA: What is kept in the Louvre?
items.answer: SB: Many of the world's most famous paintings, sculptures, jewellery and other forms of art are kept in the Louvre.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'What IS kept' - savolda birlik, javobda
ko'plik 'are kept'.

items.prompt: e How many people / it / visit / every year?
items.question: SA: How many people is it visited by every year?
items.answer: SB: It is visited by millions of people every year.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete each sentence using the word in bold, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Har gapni qalin so'zdan foydalanib tugallang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
ACTIVE → PASSIVE, KALIT SO'Z BILAN.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Steven Spielberg directed the film
  'ET'. → 'ET' WAS DIRECTED BY Steven
  Spielberg.


JAVOBLAR:

  2 Sputnik 1 WAS LAUNCHED (by the
    Russians) in 1957.
  3 London IS VISITED BY MILLIONS OF
    TOURISTS every year.
  4 The chapel MUST BE REPAIRED
    immediately.
  5 The new gallery WILL BE OPENED
    BY THE QUEEN on Friday.
  6 The museum HAS BEEN REDECORATED.
  7 The TV WASN'T INVENTED BY
    Fleming.


⚠ 7-BAND - INKOR MAJHUL:

  "didn't invent" → "WASN'T
  invented"
  ⚠ Inkor 'be' ga qo'shiladi.


⚠ 'TO LAUNCH':

  = uchirmoq (raketa, sun'iy
  yo'ldosh).
  ⚠ 'Sputnik 1' - birinchi sun'iy
  yo'ldosh (SSSR, 1957).


⚠ 'TO REDECORATE':

  = qayta ta'mirlamoq (bezatmoq).


⚠ 'FLEMING':

  Alexander Fleming - penitsillin
  kashfiyotchisi (TV emas!).

items.textEn: 1 Steven Spielberg directed the film 'ET'. (BY) → 'ET' ___ Steven Spielberg.
2 The Russians launched Sputnik 1 in 1957. (WAS) → Sputnik 1 ___ in 1957.
3 Millions of tourists visit London every year. (VISITED) → London ___ every year.
items.answer: is visited by millions of tourists
items.whyUz: ⚠ visit → IS visited BY millions of tourists.

items.textEn: 4 They must repair the chapel immediately. (REPAIRED) → The chapel ___ immediately.
5 The Queen will open the new gallery on Friday. (BE) → The new gallery ___ on Friday.
items.answer: will be opened by the Queen
items.whyUz: ⚠ will open → will BE opened BY the Queen.

items.textEn: 6 They have redecorated the museum. (BEEN) → The museum ___ .
items.whyUz:
⚠ have redecorated → HAS BEEN redecorated.
⚠ 'They' tushiriladi.

items.textEn: 7 Fleming didn't invent the TV. (INVENTED) → The TV ___ Fleming.

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI INShOOT - BESh SAVOL.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (Eyfel minorasi):
  SA: Where is the Eiffel Tower
      located?
  SB: It is located in Paris, France.
      Who was it designed by?
  SA: It was designed by Gustave
      Eiffel. When was it completed?
  SB: It was completed in 1889. What
      is it made of?
  SA: It is made of iron. Why was it
      built?
  SB: It was built as a memorial to
      the French Revolution.


PARFENON:
  Name: Parthenon, Athens, Greece
  Designer: Ictinus & Callicrates
  Completed: 432 BC
  Material: marble
  Built as: temple of goddess Athena


⚠ 'TO BE LOCATED IN':

  = ... da joylashgan.
  ⚠ 'location' = joylashuv.


⚠ 'A MEMORIAL TO':

  = ... xotirasiga yodgorlik.
  ⚠ Eyfel minorasi 1889 - Fransuz
  inqilobining 100 yilligi.


⚠ 'MARBLE':

  = marmar.


⚠ 'A TEMPLE':

  = ibodatxona (qadimgi).
  ⚠ 'goddess' = ma'buda; 'god' =
  xudo.
  ⚠ Athena - donolik ma'budasi.

items.answer: SA: It was designed by Gustave Eiffel.

items.answer: It was built as a temple of the goddess Athena.

modelAnswers: The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, in France. It was designed by Gustave Eiffel and it was completed in 1889. It is made of iron. It was built as a memorial to the French Revolution.
The Parthenon is located in Athens, in Greece. It was designed by Ictinus and Callicrates and it was completed in 432 BC. It is made of marble. It was built as a temple of the goddess Athena.
modelAnswersUz: Eyfel minorasi Fransiyaning Parij shahrida joylashgan. Uni Gustav Eyfel loyihalagan va u 1889 yilda qurib bitirilgan. U temirdan yasalgan. U Fransuz inqilobi xotirasiga yodgorlik sifatida qurilgan.

patterns.formula: Who was [nima] + 3-ShAKL by? - It was + 3-ShAKL by [kim].
patterns.exampleEn: Who was America discovered by? - It was discovered by Christopher Columbus.
patterns.exampleUz: Amerikani kim kashf etgan? - Uni Kristofer Kolumb kashf etgan.

patterns.formula: When was it + 3-ShAKL? - It was + 3-ShAKL in [yil].
patterns.exampleEn: When was it discovered? - It was discovered in 1492.

patterns.formula: [Nima] is located in [joy]. It was designed by [kim] and completed in [yil]. It is made of [material]. It was built as [nima].
patterns.exampleEn: The Parthenon is located in Athens. It was designed by Ictinus and Callicrates and completed in 432 BC. It is made of marble. It was built as a temple.
patterns.exampleUz: Parfenon Afinada joylashgan. Uni Iktin va Kallikrat loyihalagan, mil. av. 432 yilda bitirilgan. Marmardan. Ibodatxona sifatida qurilgan.
